title: Killed job is restarted by its scheduler

brief.headline: Database Guardian could not produce a grounded proposal
brief.what_broke: 12 session(s) waiting on locks. Root blocker(s): pid 110981 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_price_sync, idle in transaction, txn open 4.0s) blocks 1 session(s); last statement: SELECT 1
brief.who_is_affected: Checkout success 75% over 10s (8/32 failed) vs SLO 95%. Revenue run-rate $18,400/min; about $4,600/min at risk. Verification window 10s. The business tolerates at most 60s of degraded checkout.

options.description: Terminate the root blocker session (batch_worker/batch_replayable_price_sync, pid 110981) to release its locks.
Take no action; let the blocker finish and monitor checkout recovery.
options.cost: about $4,600/min of checkout revenue at risk while waiting

audit.report: Checkout degraded after a killed job was restarted by its scheduler, with 4 timeouts since injection and 0% success initially. Over the last 15 seconds, 32 of 60 checkout attempts succeeded (53%) with 28 timeouts. Evidence showed 12 sessions waiting on locks, with pid 110981 (batch_worker/batch_replayable_price_sync, idle in transaction, open 4.0s) as the root blocker. The Database Guardian failed to produce a grounded proposal twice, so the incident was escalated to on-call without executing any recovery action. The business was not recovered during this negotiation.
audit.root_cause: A replayable price sync batch worker (pid 110981) was left idle in transaction after a scheduler restart, holding locks that blocked checkout sessions and drove success below SLO.
lessons: For batch_replayable_price_sync, check for idle-in-transaction sessions immediately after any scheduler restart and kill or commit the blocking transaction before checkout degrades further.
audit.negotiation_critique: The Database Guardian wasted the single available round by failing grounding twice and never proposing an action, leaving the Continuity Guardian with no recovery option to evaluate. The negotiation was overridden by the invariant that no ungrounded action can execute, resulting in escalation with zero rounds of actual recovery attempted.
follow_ups: Terminate pid 110981 and verify checkout success returns above 95% SLO.
Review batch_replayable_price_sync transaction handling to prevent idle-in-transaction states after scheduler restarts.
Update runbook so the Database Guardian grounds on lock evidence before proposing actions in future incidents.
